policies.source: Reviewed 2026-09-14: The Tank Club Dreadsail Reef Trial Tank Guide says Tideborn Taleria Boss 3 Basics: taunt the boss and stand to the right of the group; ESO-Hub Dreadsail Reef Tideborn Taleria guide says Taleria attacks the player with aggro (the tank, ideally), Sea Behemoths spawn on the main tank/player with Taleria aggro, and Crashing Wave tracks the main tank. Sources: https://thetankclub.com/eso-dreadsail-reef-trial-tank-guide/ ; https://eso-hub.com/en/guides/Dreadsail-Reef-Guide/boss-3-tideborn-taleria

Reviewed 2026-09-14: Xynode and Alcast Rockgrove guides establish Xalvakka's 100-70%, 70-40%, and 40-0% active boss phases with retreats at 70% and 40%; ESOAZ describes Xalvakka waiting on the next platform and resuming at the phase boundary. Public ESO Logs report XVMgLdq6GpQ7bhKN provided repeated runtime corroboration: four 70% transition observations resumed at approximately 70% HP and three 40% transition observations resumed at approximately 40% HP. Reviewed empirical transition timing is stored separately in data/encounter_transition_timing/reviewed.json and is a planning estimate, not a fixed game constant.
